title: AlphaDog Styles Unisex T-Shirt for Adults - Dog Breed Geometric Heart, Front Emblem and Full Body Back Print
desc:
Wear your best friend. Bold geometric faceted illustration with a heart of your dog's breed on a soft unisex tee: a small emblem portrait on the front and the full body drawing across the back.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the shirt color.
3. Size: pick your size.

FABRIC AND FIT
Bella+Canvas 3001 unisex jersey tee, about 4.2 oz, 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (heather shades include some polyester). Soft, lightweight retail fit that runs true to size - size up for a relaxed fit.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean the print.
